criteria.evidence: The repository includes a test case under `tests/feasibility/test_preflight.py` that defines a problem with only hard constraints and verifies that the planner can find at least one solution. This satisfies the requirement of having a satisfiable problem without any soft constraints.

The repository does not contain any tests that verify a group staying together exceeding table capacity, nor is there a test for the rule naming a group larger than any table. No evidence was found for this criterion in the provided files.
No test case verifies that a same-table and a different-table hard rule over the same guest pair is reported as a contradiction naming both rules. No such verification was found in the repository.
The repository does not contain any test that checks for a rule named "no soft" or "soft" constraints, nor a test that verifies no rules are added. No evidence was found for this criterion.

findings.summary: Missing tests for FR-001 and FR-002: The repository does not contain any test files that verify a rule naming a group larger than any table or a same-table/different-table hard constraint conflict. No
